subject: Creativity
title: The Double Diamond: Diverge, Converge, Repeat
description: Learn The Double Diamond: Diverge, Converge, Repeat in one minute.

hook.text: The British Design Council mapped how designers work: two diamonds — first find the right problem, then the right solution.

buildup.text: Diamond 1: Discover widely (diverge), then Define precisely (converge).

discovery.text: Most teams jump straight to solutions. The Double Diamond forces them to spend equal time understanding the problem.

twist.text: The model looks linear but isn't. Teams loop back constantly — discovering mid-delivery that they defined the problem.

climax.text: Governments (UK, Singapore), corporations (IBM, Google), and NGOs all use it — a universal creative framework.

punchline.text: Two diamonds: one for the problem, one for the solution.

quiz.question: What does the first diamond in the Double Diamond model focus on?
options: Finding and defining the right problem
